sections.section_title: DCMIPP Pipe1 statistics window size register (DCMIPP_P1STSZR)
sections.text_helper: Section 39.14.52 "DCMIPP Pipe1 statistics window size register (DCMIPP_P1STSZR)" in chapter 39 (Digital camera interface pixel pipeline (DCMIPP)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 1940.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x860
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bit 31 CROPEN:
0: Bypass, all pixels are used to compute the statistics
1: Enable, only the rectangle defined by VSTART, HSTART, VSIZE, HSIZE is used for
statistics.
Bits 30:28 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 27:16 VSIZE[11:0]: Vertical size, from 0 to 4094 pixels high
If the value is kept at 0 when enabling the crop with the CROPEN bit, the value is forced
internally at the maximum value 0xFFE.
Bits 15:12 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 11:0 HSIZE[11:0]: Horizontal size, from 0 to 4094 pixels wide
If the value is kept at 0 when enabling the crop with the CROPEN bit, the value is forced
internally at the maximum value 0xFFE.
